crn.note: row params seeded by (seed,fam,traj); noise by chunk seed; tuning tiles noise per candidate

metrics.primary: median over test rows of 3D position RMSE on true states, t>=3 s; diverged row = inf
metrics.diverged: |p-ref|>2 m, tilt>60 deg or z<0.01 at any time
metrics.xtrack: zigzag: rms of xy error normal to v_ref where |v_ref|>=0.05

constraints.family_margin: every family median <= 1.1 x tuned PID

stats.bootstrap: paired percentile, 2000 resamples, seed 0, over rows

tuner.method: CMA-ES (mu/mu_w,lambda) in normalised PARAMS box, start = defaults, candidate 0 = default

calibration.fit: POOR: closed-loop replay NRMSE ~1.0-1.2 (calib_replay_v1.json) => results are RELATIVE only
calibration.b_pick: b=8 dps2/U: replay near-best set {8,11,16}; only b=8 has no 3-8 Hz limit cycle in the full model (logs: <=1% 3-8 Hz power) (calib_check_v1.json)
calibration.z_offset: sim -0.20 m at 15.8 V, -0.58 m at 15.0 V, 0.00 at 16.6 V; logs 0.3-0.5 m low (qualitative match)
known_limits: firmware Z authority: throttle <= 2950+300 => payload 1.3x cannot hover near z0 (firmware limit, kept)
OF/ToF/EKF are steady-state KF approximations of EkfOf, not the firmware code
